summary: Satya, co-host and co-creator of the Melanin Millennials podcast, publicly detailed his removal from the show by the Shout Out Network (SON) after they claimed ownership of the trademark without his consent. He revealed that despite a verbal agreement stating the creators owned the content, SON proceeded to replace him with new hosts and alter the format in August 2017. Satya expressed deep disappointment over the lack of transparency and agency, stating his intention to reclaim ownership of the content he created.
